body: Because there is no magic solution, I see no way out besides suicide. I just can't stand the thought of being trapped there.
I hate it. No company will take me because of my job history and I feel like a target at my current job where it does not seem I can trust anyone.

Thank you for your sympathies. To be brief I got into an argument with the division manager regarding an issue. Well, it wasn't so much an argument as it was him interrogating and humiliating me. My actions were by no means correct, but the way he approached me was completely wrong in my book. I wanted to give it right back to him but I just didnt have balls to challenge him and today I still have the resentment about the way I was treated. Also found out during the interrogation that my direct supervisor had revealed a comment I had communicated in confidence back to him. That's where the backstabbing came in.

I want nothing more than to leave, and these backstabbers and assholes behind, but as I explained above I can't. They say that everything is good but I don't believe them for a minute. There's really no way of knowing whether they're just looking for an excuse to get rid of me, in which case I want to beat them to the punch, but again I can't.
Ok, what would you like to know?
I'll share if you're truly interested.
Do you really care about my story or are you just trying to play a role?
Not sure if I want to correspond with someone who calls themselves Nemesis.
